messages:
ana: hi everyone! tiny question: where's the best place to ask about API keys and sandbox access? also prefer to ask infra/setup vs product questions in threads?

devin: hey ana, API keys / sandbox -> #help (tag @it-ops) or DM the infra on-call if urgent. For product-level sandbox or test data, ask in #product or your squad channel. Threads are good for follow-ups, DMs for sensitive info like tokens.

ryan: quick procedural note: never paste API keys in channels, always use a ticket or DM to an appropriate person and mark the ticket private if it contains secrets. Use the secrets rotation doc in #docs.

onboarding-bot: Hi Ana! To request sandbox access run `/access request sandbox`. You will get a follow-up DM with expected turnaround.

ana: thanks y'all! saved the commands and won't paste keys here :thumbsup:
